tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products from online stores that ship to AU. Each result is one seller's offer with price (AUD), availability, product_id, seller and variants[].variant_id. When a seller offers a discount code, its results also have discounted_price (what the user pays; the code is applied through checkout_u

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for a product: description, every variant with its options (size, colour, ...), the seller's shipping and refund policy links, and (in sellers) what the seller tells buyers about itself: ABN, delivery times, returns, support contacts, ratings. Pass seller_id to limit to one seller's off

tools.name: create_checkout_links
tools.description: Creates a checkout link per seller for the chosen variants. Give each checkout_url to the user: it opens the seller's own checkout with the items pre-filled, where the user reviews delivery and pays. Pass the user's postcode to get each seller's delivery options and an estimated_total including deli
